parent_objective: combined M223/M231 preferred-only snippet action anchor
combined M223/M231 outcome intervention auxiliary loss

forbidden_shortcuts: do not loosen replay or protected-key thresholds
do not lengthen PPO before this one-smoke gate passes
do not promote if protected key fails even when fixed loss improves
hypothesis: Using the combined M223/M231 snippet anchor during PPO should preserve the replay proof surface and the historical protected key better than M229, which anchored only M223 snippets.
success_criteria: run exactly one 1024-step PPO smoke from M224 with the M232 combined corpus
improve or at least not regress the fixed objective against M224 within the existing smoke tolerance
retain behavior seed success at the M224 level
pass protected key 9944 within the existing normal-margin window
failure_criteria: any old or current replay gate loses normal-history success retention
PPO is lengthened or repeated before the one-smoke result is audited

commands.name: m233_train
commands.command: Create a M233 smoke config from M229 with outcome_intervention_snapshot_npz and snippet_action_anchor_snapshot_npz set to the M232 combined corpus, then run one 1024-step PPO smoke from M224.

commands.name: m233_gates
commands.command: Evaluate fixed objective, old/current replay gates, behavior seeds, and protected key before any repeat or longer PPO.

decision_rule: M233 may admit only a repeat PPO smoke if fixed objective and replay behavior protected-key gates all pass. Any protected-key failure rejects the smoke and triggers audit instead of repeat.
next_blocker: Run the M233 one-smoke PPO gate and decide between repeat PPO or protected-key-aware objective audit.
